title: Event-Centric Earthquake Monitoring with a Multi-Station Transformer
abstract: arXiv:2610.17404v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Earthquake catalogs underpin studies such as fault structure, earthquake processes and seismic hazard, and their value depends on being both complete and reliable. Machine learning has improved individual tasks of earthquake monitoring, but processing stations independently discards the consistency of arrivals across the network, and running tasks in sequence fragments the information describing each earthquake. We present EQNet2, a geometry-aware multi-station Transformer that jointly predicts phase arrivals, first-motion polarities, source location and magnitude, and the association of arrivals into events. On a Northern California test dataset and on continuous waveforms from Ridgecrest and the San Francisco Bay Area, EQNet2 recovers more weak arrivals, produces fewer false detections, and associates more picks into located events. translated_title: 基于多台站Transformer的事件中心地震监测
translated_abstract: 地震目录是断层结构、地震过程和地震危险性等研究的基础，其价值取决于完整性与可靠性。机器学习已经改进了地震监测的各项单独任务，但独立处理各台站会丢弃整个台网间到时的一致性信息，而按顺序运行各项任务则割裂了描述每次地震的信息。我们提出了EQNet2，一个具有几何感知能力的多台站Transformer，可联合预测震相到时、初动极性、震源位置和震级，以及到时与事件的关联。在北加州测试数据集以及来自Ridgecrest和旧金山湾区的连续波形数据上，EQNet2恢复了更多微弱到时，产生了更少的误检，并将更多拾取关联到可定位的事件中。其学习到的注意力机制沿着与……一致的时间-距离模式连接跨台站的信息（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出几何感知的多台站Transformer模型EQNet2，联合预测震相到时、初动极性、震源位置与震级并完成事件关联，在北加州数据上恢复了更多微弱震相、减少误检并显著提升事件定位效果。
en_tdlr: EQNet2, a geometry-aware multi-station Transformer, jointly predicts phase arrivals, first-motion polarities, source locations, magnitudes and event associations, recovering more weak arrivals and reducing false detections on California datasets.
